title: 110 painted item icons: crops, pets, eggs, tools, food, decor, merchants
summary: 110 glossy painted cartoon icons, 256x256 PNG with transparent background and a warm brown outline: 26 crops/fruit/flowers, 24 chibi pet portraits, 9 eggs, 12 tools, 12 foods and stations, 24 decorations, 3 merchant portraits.
use_when: Inventory, shop, hotbar, collection book, quest or reward UI in farming, cozy, pet, crafting or casual games. Currency, UI and rarity icons live in ui-kit-core/icons instead.
how_to_use: Load res://starter/ui-icons/<folder>/<id>.png as a Texture2D: TextureRect (expand_mode = EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE, stretch_mode = KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED, texture_filter = LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS), Sprite2D, or with ui-kit-core: UI.icon(...) then icon.texture = load(path); ui-juice hotbar items {"icon": load(path), "count": 3}; fx.reward_banner("NEW PET!", "Ember Fox", load("res://starter/ui-icons/pet/ember_fox.png")). Icons are mipmapped; display them at 48-128 px. Ids are listed per folder in contents.
